name: @epoch/authentication
description: Epoch Authentication/Session Seam (W046, ACR-005) — the provider-neutral session layer over the W009 identity/tenancy/authorization kernels: session issuance projected from VERIFIED @epoch/identity authentication results (content-addressed session ids from caller-supplied entropy — zero randomness), the session lifecycle (active -> expired / revoked, evaluated against caller-supplied instants — zero wall-clock), digest-disciplined session records (immutable content + lifecycle state + SHA-256 content address; lifecycle transitions never rewrite the digest), deterministic snapshots + restore-from-durable-records (the service layer mirrors records through the persistence SPI), and the tenant-safe authorization propagation helper (AuthorizationRequest construction from a session scope; decisions stay @epoch/authorization's fail-closed evaluator — this seam NEVER decides). NO IdP, NO network, NO secret storage: assertions are descriptors; tokens are never modeled.
